entries.english:
Wednesday after St Bartholomew's Day (26 August). Arnold, Eberhard, Konrad, Thomas, and Hans von Rosenberg, acting on the emperor's commission, announce that he has granted the lordships of Münzenberg, Falkenstein, and Königstein, with all their appurtenances and the Rhine tolls, to Konrad von Weinsberg. They are to support Konrad von Weinsberg in exercising his lordship.

Parchment, with the seal of the court of the Empire impressed upon it.

Date: 26 August 1422, Nuremberg

Extent: 1 charter
